# A paired load must fault exactly as the two unpaired loads would:
# with the second 16-byte half on a PROT_NONE page, the fused FLDPQ
# and the split FMOVQ pair report the same faulting address, the
# first byte of the unmapped page. The mapping is fixed so the
# address is constant across runs, natively and under qemu.
[!exec:qemu-aarch64] skip 'qemu-aarch64 is required for the arm64 leg'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

cd m
env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o $WORK/fault-arm64$GOEXE .
env GOARCH=
! exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/fault-arm64$GOEXE paired
stderr 'unexpected fault address 0x40001000'
! exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/fault-arm64$GOEXE unpaired
stderr 'unexpected fault address 0x40001000'

logos build -o $WORK/fault-native$GOEXE .
! exec $WORK/fault-native$GOEXE paired
stderr 'unexpected fault address 0x40001000'
! exec $WORK/fault-native$GOEXE unpaired
stderr 'unexpected fault address 0x40001000'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/pairfaultaddr

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"simd/archsimd"
)

type pair16 struct {
	A [16]byte
	B [16]byte
}

type pad1024 struct {
	Pad [1024]byte
	A   [16]byte
	B   [16]byte
}

const fixedBase = 0x40000000

func main() {
	page := syscall.Getpagesize()
	r1, _, errno := syscall.Syscall6(syscall.SYS_MMAP, fixedBase, uintptr(2*page), syscall.PROT_READ|syscall.PROT_WRITE, syscall.MAP_ANON|syscall.MAP_PRIVATE|syscall.MAP_FIXED, ^uintptr(0), 0)
	if errno != 0 || r1 != fixedBase {
		fmt.Println("fixed mmap failed", errno)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	mem := unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(uintptr(fixedBase))), 2*page)
	if err := syscall.Mprotect(mem[page:], syscall.PROT_NONE); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("mprotect failed", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "unpaired" {
		s := (*pad1024)(unsafe.Pointer(&mem[page-1040]))
		a := archsimd.LoadUint8x16Array(&s.A)
		b := archsimd.LoadUint8x16Array(&s.B)
		var o1, o2 [16]byte
		a.StoreArray(&o1)
		b.StoreArray(&o2)
		fmt.Println("survived", o1, o2)
		return
	}
	s := (*pair16)(unsafe.Pointer(&mem[page-16]))
	a := archsimd.LoadUint8x16Array(&s.A)
	b := archsimd.LoadUint8x16Array(&s.B)
	var o1, o2 [16]byte
	a.StoreArray(&o1)
	b.StoreArray(&o2)
	fmt.Println("survived", o1, o2)
}
